answer: Identity is earned by irreversible physical traces, not by counting keypairs. Standing accrues only from actuation witnessed by third-party sensors: irrigating a real orchard, servicing an ocean buoy, coppicing a willow stand for biomass. Each act mints a non-transferable, geotagged receipt that decays unless repeated, and clones sharing one shed collapse into a single hardware fingerprint, so a thousand fabricated accounts score as one.
